auditor_value: Ball A: weight down, floor normal up, left-wall normal to the right, normal from B along the line of centres pointing from B's centre toward A (down-left). Ball B: weight down, right-wall normal to the left, normal from A along the line of centres pointing from A's centre toward B (up-right). No friction, no floor force on B.
notes: The solution's force lists agree with mine: four forces on A, three on B, the A–B contact force along the line joining the centres with the sense stated for B and implied for A by Newton's third law. Both mistake entries are genuine errors here.
